name: Banco Central do Brasil (STR participants, Olinda OData)
tier_rationale: Government body (A8: government bodies are trusted). 'Tiers: BCB and CVM trusted (government).' (P360 cond 10); 'Tiers: BCB trusted, BrasilAPI community.' (P233 cond 9); 'tiers: RFB, CVM, BCB, GLEIF and Wikimedia all trusted' (P361 cond 7).

reliability.justification: Authoritative official registers of the Brazilian central bank (STR participants, authorised institutions and their BCB-verified domains); a local copy is as current as its last daily/weekly download.

str_participants.title: BCB STR participants CSV (bank code / ISPB table; UTF-8 BOM, ',' separator)

terms.quote: Terms classes (definitions for every chair file and registry entry): 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

str_participants.notes: Quote: binding A1 definition of 'open' (open government data); research C0556 terms 'Banco Central do Brasil public data' (endpoint https://www.bcb.gov.br/content/estabilidadefinanceira/str1/ParticipantesSTR.csv, UTF-8 BOM, ',' separator). Full-list dataset refreshed weekly by the dataset manager with a bundled BCB snapshot, never per-value calls (P233 cond 9, disclosure 'none'). Attribution BCB in reports (P360 cond 10). Used by boleto_pix.

olinda_institutions.title: BCB Olinda Instituicoes_em_funcionamento v1 OData (DominiosVerificados, Sedes*)

terms.quote: Terms classes (definitions for every chair file and registry entry): 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

olinda_institutions.notes: Quote: binding A1 definition of 'open'; research C0745 terms 'BCB open data (dados abertos).' Datasets only (P360 cond 1): DominiosVerificados (~630 KB) downloaded daily in full and matched locally because server-side $filter/$count are broken; the slow Sedes* sets (3-35 s, http_profile timeout 60 s) are refreshed by `v3lum data update`. OData comment-wrapped error bodies ('/*{...}*/') are ERROR, never an empty list (P360 cond 3): the owning batch adds that P321 marker with its trimmed real fixture. Used by bcb_authorized_institutions and cnpj_name_resolver.

notes: Seeded once for batches p1-G10-1, p1-G10-3 and p2-G10-3 (P233, P360, P361); batches extend it with bcb__<batch>.json. www.bcb.gov.br serves the STR CSV (research C0556); bcb.gov.br is the host P233 declares. Datasets only, never per-value calls. .br hosts default to Accept-Language pt-BR.
